_doc: One row per codec call. The ring, open/close sounds and the contact's portrait come from the player's MGS Delta install (mgs_assets.json keys). lines: [speaker id, text].

lines: Snake, this is Major Zero. Can you hear me?
Loud and clear. Why does this forest have a school in it?
That's your target. Yamaku Academy, a Soviet boarding school for students with disabilities. On paper.
Intelligence says it's a front for a long-term infiltration program. Codename: Operation Long Ramp.
We don't know. That's the trouble. Whatever it is, Moscow has budgeted for it until 1990.
You go in as Hisao Nakai, a transfer student. Make contact with the students. Find out what they're planning.
Undercover at a school. In the snow. Got it.
Major. There's a ramp at the main gate. Gold leaf.
Remarkable. Photograph it if you can. Washington will want to know what it costs.
Snake, it's Para-Medic. Zero told me you met a girl who runs on prosthetic legs?
She hit me at full speed. Felt like a jeep.
Did you know there's a film where... no, never mind. Snake, these students aren't weak. They're adapted. Every one of them has learned to beat a world that wasn't built for them.
If the Soviets have trained that into a spy program, they might be the most dangerous unit you've ever faced.
Major, I think I understand the plan.
They want the West to build ramps. Braille signs. Lifts on buses. Everywhere. All of it.
Good Lord. The cost would be astronomical.
...And the worst part is, it's a good idea.
That's what makes it brilliant, Snake. Get those blueprints.
Major, I've got them. It's legislation. An American law. They've written our law for us.
Then the infiltration is already complete. Snake, get out of there. Now.
